reviews.x: I was looking for rat tail combs for my kit and found these in the search results. They looked so pretty so I bought one to check it out. It is an exquisite thing! I didn't know about the secret of the wooden comb. It has this gentleness to it and glides through hair so smoothly- thoroughly and smoothly. And it smells so good. Anyway, I bought one more for my boyfriend and one more for me and a couple other styles just to check them out and I am hooked! It a beautiful object that works masterful

reviews.t: THE BEST COMB I'VE EVER OWNED!!!
reviews.x: LOVE IT, LOVE IT, LOVE IT!!!! It's solid, easy to grip, the teeth don't scratch my scalp. It's quality through and through. I see this lasting the rest of my lifetime. You know what else? The price is very reasonably when I think about how I paid $3 and $4 for cheap plastic combs that scraped my scalp and broke before a year was even up. Treat yourself and buy one of these. You won't be sorry.

I am elderly with thinning hair.  This comb is very good.  It has more heft than other combs I have used.  After combing my hair, there is no hair on the comb.  Occasionally, there may be one or two strands,  but not usually.  My hair seems to lay nicer too.  I would recommend this comb.

The comb I received smelled like bug spray (i.e., Raid...)  The comb itself was durable, well-made and acceptable in every other way, but for the repugnant odor. Maybe it was just that particular one - don't know.  Just seemed as though this comb was made from toxic ingredients.

reviews.t: I love that its wooden and works great at combing out ...
reviews.x: This very fancy comb is worth every penny. I love that its wooden and works great at combing out my hair when its wet. But since my hair is very curly I can't use it when my hair is dry, but I don't usually comb/brush it when its dry, so it works out perfect. The tail is very sharp and works well with parting my hair. Great product and Great Service from the seller.

This is a great comb. I use it for parting, teasing and smoothing. If you are trying to remove some of the plastic from your life and use more natural products, getting this rat tail comb is a great start. Durable, attractive, easy to use.
Doesn't pull or cause static. A very beautiful comb but noticed the teeth aren't as durable as I'd have hoped. Returned and trying a different comb. What a shame because I liked how pretty this is.

reviews.t: Not happy looked dull and used .
reviews.x: Didn't like how I received it looked used dull looking had no shine finished first time I ever received a comb like it.  I was sad when I saw it. God bless everyone
Great product for keeping your hair healthy.  I Love the smell!

Having just watched a program about how medieval women kept their hair clean with only washing maybe once a year (!) it turns out they used a very fine toothed comb - almost like a lice comb and kept their hair covered.  I use wooden combs anyway just not the fine ones so I bought this really beautiful well made comb and went outside to do my hundred brushes and could not believe the dust/debris  I created!!  I know it spreads the oils out better and the combing is good for your scalp.  I think

reviews.t: and it moves easily through our girls' thick hair
reviews.x: We've gone through many plastic combs (the rat tail ends would snap off). This comb is rigid enough to endure, and it moves easily through our girls' thick hair.
This comb is well made and sturdy.  It glides through my hair and doesn't snag or pull.  I oiled it with grape seed oil when I first got it, and it is wonderful.
Beautiful and functional.  The teeth are very smooth and glide through hair easily.  I'm very happy with the purchase.

reviews.t: It was exactly as described and even came in a nice little bag
reviews.x: Comb came sooner than expected. It was exactly as described and even came in a nice little bag. Very nice comb.

reviews.t: Dropped it, rat tail split and that was that ...
reviews.x: Dropped it , rat tail split and that was that . Can't use the pointed end ever again .

It is very high quality and very sturdy.  Initially, it took me a while to get used to the smell.  It's sandalwood, and it has a unique smell that at first was a bit off-putting, but now I kind of like it.  The smell is also fading a bit now that I leave the comb sitting out on the counter top when I'm not using it.  Either that or I've gotten more used to the smell and just don't notice it as much.  If this comb is hand made, it's made by someone who has been doing it long enough that they've m

This hair comb is good looking but I didn't like how its actually designed. I mean if you notice its top head is not sharp which makes it difficult to divide your hair especially if you have thicker hair. Usually when I blow dry my hair. I like to divide it into 4 parts. Now with brush its hard to do so. I do use the end sharp part of the comb holder to divide my hair.

I am used to using a plastic rat tail comb, which as you all know, can be pretty flimsy. This wooden comb is larger than what I previously used, but I got used to the change quickly. It is good quality, sturdy, and looks nice too. It also came in a cute little storage bag. I have no complaints!

I have really thick natural black hair, so it pulls my hair out and I only use it after I've detangled.  I think it will work great with straight hair.  I will definitely use it when I flat iron my hair, but that is only every once in a while.  I do love the sturdiness of the comb.

Love this comb, very high quality and come with super cute kimono bag. I use this comb to separate my hair into section before i roll them. Plastic comb keeps breaking and scratch my sculp. This comb is like massaging my head. I am going to order another one to be kept in my purse.

This is the second one of these combs that I purchased from this company. This first one still has that heavenly Sandalwood scent. This new comb has a different, not especially pleasant scent. I have to wonder if an alternative wood was used?

It surpassed my expectations.  Beautiful wooden comb, and can smell the wood it's made from.  It appears sturdy and strong.  It arrived in a cloth gift bag, just perfect to stuff a stocking.  Just love it!!!

reviews.t: This is a very pretty comb! I love the color and feel of ...
reviews.x: This is a very pretty comb! I love the color and feel of the wood. It seems like it would be more sturdy and not break as often as the cheap plastic versions I usually buy. I'd highly recommend this.
Beautifully packaged and designed. Looks and feels expensive. Nice weight. It doesn't work for my personal needs as a hairdresser. The tail isn't long enough. The teeth could be a bit longer.
The fine end of the stick is so thick that it doesn’t part hair well which is half to purpose of the product. I wouldn’t recommend. Don’t give it as a good gift. It’s essentially junk.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the comb for gliding smoothly through hair without snagging or pulling.
Many customers describe the comb as well-made, sturdy, and durable.
Several reviewers highlight the comb's attractive, beautiful appearance.
A few reviewers report durability problems, including fragile teeth and a rat tail that split after being dropped.
A small number of reviewers mention negative issues with odor or the item arriving looking used and dull.
